title: WITHOUT HIM I CAN DO NOTHING

lines.text: Without Him I can do nothing
Without Him Id surely fail,
Without Him I would be drifting
Like a boat without a sail.
But with Him I can do all things
And with Him I cannot fail,
And over the stormiest ocean
In perfect peace Ill sail.
Without Him I would be dying
Without Him Id be enslaved
Without Him life would be hopeless
But with Jesus, thank God, Im saved.
So Ill ask Him to be my Pilot
His Word my compass and guide,
Till Ive anchored safely in glory
For without Him Id drift with the tide.
Jesus, my Jesus,
Do you know Him today,
You cant turn Him away
O Jesus, O Jesus
Without Him how lost I would be.
